audited_source_corrections.action: Changed the numeral proved equal to t_2 from n to m, its stipulated value in the standard model.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The proof fixes n as the value of t_1 and m as the value of t_2, but then says Q proves t_2 equals numeral n before splitting into the n=m and n-not-equal-m cases.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் காட்டல் t_2 ஐ அதன் நிலைப்படுத்தப்பட்ட மதிப்பான m இன் எண்குறிக்குச் சமப்படுத்துகிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Keeping numeral n, which assumes the equality case before the case distinction; renaming both fixed values.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: The closed-term lemma applied to t_2 uniquely yields its own value m.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Does the corrected pair of equalities now support both the equality and inequality cases?

audited_source_corrections.action: Changed the closed numeral equality from n plus successor k to successor k plus n so it matches the Q8 witness formula used in the next inference.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: Q8 defines x<y using z-prime plus x, but the frozen proof establishes n plus k-prime and then swaps the addends without deriving commutativity in Q.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் காட்டல் மூடிய சொல் துணைத்தேற்றத்தை நேரடியாக k-prime plus n என்ற வரிசையில் பயன்படுத்தி, அடுத்த Q8 நேர்வுடன் பொருந்தச் செய்கிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Assuming unproved global commutativity in Q; adding a separate commutativity lemma not available here.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: Both closed terms have value m, so atomic completeness directly proves the correctly ordered equality without any commutativity principle.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Does substituting t_1 for numeral n now yield exactly successor witness plus t_1 equals t_2?

audited_source_corrections.action: Changed both contradiction citations from Q3 to Q2, the axiom that no successor equals zero.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: Both contradictions have the form successor equals zero. Q2 states x-prime is not zero, whereas Q3 states that every nonzero number is a successor.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் இரண்டு முரண்பாட்டுப் படிகளிலும் வழிவரு சுழிக்குச் சமமல்ல என்று கூறும் Q_2 ஐச் சுட்டுகிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Retaining Q3; changing the contradiction formulas to fit Q3.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: The displayed contradictions instantiate Q2 directly and do not instantiate Q3.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Do both axiom citations now justify the exact successor-equals-zero contradictions displayed?

audited_source_corrections.action: Changed empty disjunction to empty conjunction in the zero-bound base case for the bounded universal formula.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The lemma's first clause expands a bounded universal formula into a finite conjunction, and at bound zero that conjunction is true; the frozen proof instead calls it an empty disjunction while assigning it the truth constant.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் அனைத்தளவை நேர்வுக்குரிய வெற்று இணைப்பை மெய் மாறிலியாக எடுத்துக்கொள்கிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Keeping empty disjunction while calling it true; switching to the existential clause.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: An empty conjunction is true and is exactly the k=0 instance of the conjunction on the right side of clause one.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Does the base case now name the same Boolean operation used in the lemma's universal clause?

audited_source_corrections.action: Wrapped A(x) as the second argument of the bounded existential macro under negation.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The bounded existential macro requires a bound argument and a matrix argument, but the frozen expression leaves A(x) outside the macro braces.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் வெளிப்பாடு A(x) ஐ வரம்பிட்ட இருத்தலளவை மேட்ரிக்சாக இரண்டாம் கட்டளையுருப்பில் வைக்கிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Leaving the matrix outside the macro; rewriting the bounded quantifier in expanded ordinary-existential form.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: The companion bounded formulas throughout the section and the stated macro convention fix the intended two-argument syntax.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Is A(x) now scoped by the bounded existential quantifier exactly as required by the duality step?

audited_source_corrections.action: Changed the opening Sigma-one witness formula in the final proof to the documented two-optional-argument lexists syntax.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The final proof begins with lexists using a mandatory brace argument followed by an unscoped formula, while the definition and concluding line use the documented optional variable and matrix arguments.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் இறுதிக் காட்டல் வரையறையிலும் முடிவிலும் உள்ள அதே lexists[x][A(x)] வடிவைப் பயன்படுத்துகிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Keeping malformed syntax; altering the definition and conclusion to match it.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: The macro declaration and every surrounding well-formed occurrence uniquely determine the intended syntax and scope.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Does the proof now begin and end with the same well-scoped Sigma-one existential sentence?
